title: Artificial-atom arrays in moire superlattices for quantum optics
summary: Solid-state platforms are particularly attractive for quantum optics because they facilitate on-chip integration and are compatible with established semiconductor and photonic technologies. However, a major challenge in solid-state quantum optics is the fabrication of arrays of identical emitters, such as quantum dots. In this work, we propose moire superlattices as a novel solid-state platform for manipulating light at the single-photon level.
